author: Russell Brand
description:
A covid expert told Russell that a German pathologist examined a young man who died weeks after his Pfizer shot and found spike protein where sperm should have been. The expert explained that one dose contained billions of mRNA fragments producing trillions of spike proteins in the body, with no known switch off mechanism ever identified. Russell pressed for the counter argument at the time, and the explanation offered left both men stunned into silence. If the spike protein was supposed to be the dangerous part of infection, why was the body engineered to keep producing it?
